# glpi_location (Resource)

A GLPI location. Locations form a tree through parent_id. Optional attributes that are removed from the configuration keep their last value in GLPI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_location" "idc" {
  name = "IDC"
}

resource "glpi_location" "rack_a1" {
  name      = "Rack A1"
  parent_id = glpi_location.idc.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent location. 0 means top level.

### Read-Only

- `completename` (String) Full path of the location, computed by GLPI.
- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_location.example 42
```
